# SYNTHETIC fixture — not Sindhi, not Urdu

Generated by `python -m morphtok.data.synthetic` from `SyntheticSpec()` (seed 20261025).
`tests/test_synthetic_corpus.py` regenerates it and fails if the committed file differs.

* `SYNTHETIC_corpus.txt` — 1,000 lines of invented Latin-letter "words" built from 80
  random stems, 3 prefixes and 8 suffixes, with ZWNJ inserted at morpheme joins
  (p = 0.2), at other positions (p = 0.01, sometimes doubled) and ZWJ (p = 0.005).
* `SYNTHETIC_gold.tsv` — the construction-time morpheme boundaries of every word type,
  in format-stripped coordinates, split dev/test by hashed type.

These files exist only to exercise code paths. Any number computed from them describes
the generator's parameters, not a natural language.
